scope: Scoped election content and affected directory review.
checks: Carnarvon: all five live pages showed 15 council-wide candidates, 10 Town Ward, two Gascoyne/Minilya Ward, and Mark Young and Paul Shain elected unopposed. The contested council table opened without horizontal overflow at 390 CSS pixels. Unopposed events had no active clock.

Milngin: live council and ward pages showed nominations close on 20 November, both postal application cutoffs, distinct ballot receipt and Darwin-time countdown. The council page was checked at 390 CSS pixels.
Gingin: at 390 CSS pixels, live agenda link and recommendation appeared and the vacancy clock stayed inactive.
King Island and Tasman: final result tables and distinct current-office notes were visible. Tasmania map search, select, Open and Back worked at 390 CSS pixels.
limitations: Checked the affected election and representation displays. No all-place browser, independent geometry, accessibility or source certification.
Results pages and map selections were reviewed after deployment. Earlier review evidence remains in the archived report.
